new_claims.statement: For an orthonormal 2-frame with every row leverage <=1/2, arbitrary coordinate-separable phases and any invertible symmetric 2x2 B, the output density has L3 norm <=(3e)^(2/3)|det B|^(-1/3).

For exact rank three, any nonzero scalar pivot whose residual orthonormal two-frame is leverage-diffuse is paid regardless of Schur inertia, with Linfinity bound <=4sqrt(3e)(ell|det Lambda||A_ii|)^(-1/4).

unresolved_implication: Aggregate the at most three residual-heavy coordinates with a useful pivot when the residual two-frame is not diffuse, including near-light-cone pivots, before reciprocal local determinant payment; then make the finite-core argument stable under arbitrary extra spectral components.
next_step: Combine this L3 transport with account01/B07 finite-core flag decomposition; isolate the residual-heavy rows and prove a hybrid finite-core plus diffuse-remainder smoothing theorem.
